suitability_contract.probe_isolation: Static quoted shell source; data in environment; system-temp working directory; no profile/rc files; startup-script and Git-redirection environment removed; tools resolved from the candidate MSYS runtime rather than inherited PATH.
suitability_contract.trust_limit: This executes a local PATH candidate and establishes capability, not cryptographic publisher identity or protection against a malicious local runtime. Fixed installations also remain a local OS/user trust assumption.
suitability_contract.restart_retry_concurrency: Selection is evaluated afresh without persisted suitability or acceptance cache. Probe failure is fail-closed; no automatic retry-until-green. Each runtime alias/fixture is separately owned and retired in system temp.

native_nonstandard_proof: Real native Bash is reached through a fresh system-temp junction alias to installed Git. Only fixed-location availability is simulated; fallback suitability, native process startup and path conversion are real. No repository copy or persistent sibling is created; alias retired.
